title: Treasury rate-reserve plan under the fitted real-time Taylor rule
description: A fictional treasury with floating-rate debt indexed to the federal funds rate reserves, each quarter, interest at a planned rate. Candidate plans are policy-rate paths. The question is where the fitted real-time reaction function (monetary_model.fred_realtime_v2), run inside its estimated uncertainty, drives the realized rate far enough above the plan to break the treasury's tolerance. The treasury, its tolerance and its plans are invented; only the reaction function is estimated.

decision_maker.role: Treasury of a floating-rate borrower; takes the policy rate as given
decision_maker.description: Fictional. Its reserve decision does not move the policy rate, so the environment needs no response of the rate to the treasury's action.

reserve_margin.description: Reserve next quarter's interest at the last observed quarterly policy rate plus this margin.

budget.description: Liquidity set aside above the last observed rate, summed over the horizon.

objectives.description: Percentage points of rate above the reserved rate, summed over quarters.
Percentage points reserved but not needed, summed over quarters.

success_criteria.description: No quarter's realized rate exceeds the reserved rate by more than 75 bp.

policy_rate_reaction.description: Quarterly smoothed Taylor rule fitted to first-release FEDFUNDS, CPI and CBO output gap (monetary family).

evidence.note: Passes all six criteria on the 2015-2024 holdout (DM p = 0.058 against persistence, 80% interval coverage 0.861). phi_pi = 0.38 does not satisfy the Taylor principle: the pass rests on forecast skill, not on credible structural coefficients.

inflation_start.description: Four-quarter CPI inflation in the first simulated quarter.

inflation_end.description: Inflation in the eighth quarter; linear in between.

output_gap_end.description: Output gap in the eighth quarter; linear in between.

does_not_establish: Inflation and output-gap paths are declared ranges, not forecasts; no validated mechanism forecasts them.
The initial state is the last first-release quarter in the fitted panel (2024Q4), not a live reading.
